name: Deeprun Rat Roundup

angles.text: Monty’s brother uses freshly captured Deeprun rats to make rat kabobs. The rats must stay alive until cooking, or the meat spoils.

faq.answer: Monty asks passing travelers for help at the Deeprun Tram. He needs extra hands to manage the vermin along the underground line.
faq.q: Who gives the Deeprun Rat Roundup quest?

aliases: what does monty do with rats
faq.answer: Monty’s brother needs living Deeprun rats to make rat kabobs before the meat turns sour. If they die too soon, the meat spoils.
faq.q: Why does Monty need the rats captured alive?

faq.answer: Monty provides an enchanted Rat Catcher’s Flute. Play its melody near the rats, and they will follow you back to Monty’s station.
faq.q: How do you charm and round up the rats?

faq.answer: The Deeprun Tram runs underground between Stormwind and Ironforge. Monty is stationed along its platforms.
faq.q: Where does this task take place?

faq.answer: Monty mentions a brother who cooks rat kabobs but gives no name. His brother needs a steady supply of fresh, living rats so the meat does not go rancid.

aliases: why is a pirate in the tram
faq.answer: Monty speaks in heavy nautical slang and treats the tram like a ship’s deck. He has taken up pest control duties in the underground railway.
faq.q: Why does Monty talk like a pirate?

sections.body: Monty keeps pests from overrunning the Deeprun Tram. He speaks in salty sea slang and treats the tramway like a ship’s deck. Vermin scurry through the underground station. So Monty asks travelers passing along the line to help gather them.
sections.title: Vermin Beneath the Rails

sections.body: Monty gives helpers an enchanted Rat Catcher’s Flute. Its charming melody draws Deeprun rats to follow, and they must be brought back alive. Monty’s brother needs fresh rats for rat kabobs before the meat turns sour.
sections.title: A Questionable Delicacy

summary: At the Deeprun Tram, Monty asks passing travelers to round up the rats. His flute’s charming melody draws the living Deeprun rats along.
attribution: In-game quest text: Deeprun Rat Roundup
